issue.title: Reconcile provider-disabled Launch Control PNG snapshot drift
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead sase-n4.5.3 during epic sase-n4.5 landing. On clean master eba0eab7 after just install, serial visual reproduction `.venv/bin/pytest -q -n 0 -m visual tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel.py::test_models_panel_provider_disabled_png_snapshot --maxfail=1` fails deterministically: 578/1,520,532 changed pixels (0.038013%), 564 material pixels (0.037092%) in models_panel_provider_disabled_120x40. Expected and actual are both 1482x1026; visible content appears unchanged at full-image inspection, while the diff reaches outer-frame/background chrome. Determine whether this is deterministic renderer/harness variance, stale golden output, or a real layout regression; inspect expected/actual/diff artifacts, fix the fixture or implementation if unstable, and accept only an intentional focused golden change. Verify this node and relevant Models-panel visual coverage. Distinct from closed broad drift sase-dl and closed different-node fixes sase-ma/sase-co.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-dl — closed broad renderer/harness drift record; this task is intentionally one deterministic Models-panel node with a distinct 578/564-pixel signature and durable diff evidence.
RELATED: sase-ma — closed different Models-panel effort-picker drift; useful precedent for inspecting focused artifacts and accepting only an intentional golden change.
RELATED: sase-co — closed two-node visual-drift investigation; useful precedent for distinguishing a real UI change from workspace-dependent rendering.

evidence.note:
Independent reproduction plus ROOT CAUSE, from sase-n8.land in workspace sase_14 on clean master 2605324cb (git stash, after a from-scratch 'just install').

This is not a single-node renderer wobble. The exact signature this bead records for models_panel_provider_disabled_120x40 — 578/1520532 changed pixels (0.038013%), 564 material (0.037092%) — reproduces BIT-IDENTICALLY on models_panel_default_120x40, and the whole diff is one text label: the backdrop Patch filter bar renders 'exact' (src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/filter_bar.py:253) where the golden has blank chrome. Repo-wide on clean master: 41 failed / 7 passed across the six models-panel visual modules, and 6 more failures in tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots.py.

Answering this bead's open question ('deterministic renderer/harness variance, stale golden output, or a real layout regression'): it is STALE GOLDEN OUTPUT from a real, deterministic, code-caused label change — not renderer/harness variance and not a layout regression. Proof: in changespec_initial_120x40 the golden renders '[project (o)]' and current code renders '[project (B)]' (101-pixel, single-glyph diff; cropped expected/actual inspected directly). Commit 3c9df1182 'feat(ace-tui)!: unify the Artifacts keymap across Patch and its siblings' (closed phase sase-m6.9) renamed those keymap labels and touched zero PNG goldens. Every diff examined is confined to changed text; there is no scattered sub-pixel/anti-aliasing noise, so the local rasterizer is faithful and a rebaseline is trustworthy.

Two consequences for whoever works this:
  1. Scope is larger than one node — fix it as one rebaseline of the ACE goldens affected by the sase-m6.9 keymap rename, not per-node.
  2. The refreshed Launch Control goldens must also pick up 'H=History' in the context-aware footer, which sase-n8's landing commit intentionally restores for alias rows, alias-backed launch-setting rows, and the top-level bucket row (and must stay absent on scalar-setting and concrete-model rows).

Full root-cause detail is recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE note on active epic sase-m6, whose land agent is running now. See also closed task sase-lo before choosing the update mechanism.

Independent reproduction from epic sase-ns phase bead sase-ns.5 (2026-08-16, workspace sase_14), widening the blast radius this bead records: on clean master (git stash comparison), 41 PNG snapshot assertions fail across FIVE Models-panel visual modules, not one node — tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_models_panel.py, ..._models_panel_alias_history.py, ..._models_panel_edit.py, ..._models_panel_modals.py, and ..._models_panel_navigation.py. sase-ns.5 fixed only the three jump-snapshot goldens in its own scope (commit 8a769012f, task sase-mw) and confirmed the remaining 41 are pre-existing and out of that scope. Two candidate causes it identified for the drift, both landing without golden regeneration: 981106799 renamed the deterministic AliasView fixtures (large_worker/medium_worker -> xsmall/small/medium/large/xlarge) and 3c9df1182 renamed ACE keymap labels. Routed here by the sase-ns land agent.

payload.close_reason: Fixed on master f8b4ebb11; no longer reproducible. Verified in workspace sase_14 after a from-scratch 'just install' with a serial '.venv/bin/pytest -q -n 0 -m visual tests/ace/tui/visual/' run: 16 failed / 681 passed / 14 deselected, and NONE of the six models-panel visual modules' 41-node drift this bead recorded remains — test_models_panel_provider_disabled_png_snapshot passes, as do models_panel_default, _alias_history, _edit, and _modals. The stale-golden root cause diagnosed by the sase-n8.land +1 (3c9df1182 renamed ACE keymap labels and 981106799 renamed the AliasView fixtures, both landing with zero regenerated goldens) was rebaselined by epic sase-m6's coordinated golden regeneration plus 563a67fb0 'fix(tui): complete the grouping-keymap migration in the visual lane' and f3bb46f29 'fix(ace): restore the Launch Control History footer hint' (which supplied the 'H=History' footer the sase-n8.land +1 required). Two models-panel nodes still fail (test_models_panel_bucket_drilled_in_png_snapshot, test_models_panel_mixed_builtin_bucket_png_snapshot) but they are a distinct, later drift with a different signature; they are routed to the newly filed visual-drift task rather than kept here. Duplicate draft sase-np closed alongside this.
